entries.back_en: Forget everything you thought you knew. Your battles, your friends... You are now in a very different place from where you came. This world is ruled by a worldly God, a Guardian who awaits your arrival and that of your allies.

Your mission will be to find him, but it won't be easy. If you succeed, you will pass to the next plane where you will be named champion in the great battle of the Gods, Ragnarok, and receive unimaginable powers.
Tell me, soldier, are you ready to embrace glory beyond your life and this world? Find the Guardian and, with him, your place.
